h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jamshedpur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jamshedpur

items.pText: Jamshedpur grew around one of India's oldest steel plants and was planned from the start, and its parks, schools and company townships have long been run to clear standards. Many buyers here prepare a written specification or tender before they ask for quotes. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment against such specifications from our factory in Vasai, about 1,430 km away, delivered to Jharkhand by road.

A good specification describes what the equipment must do and what it is made of, without tying you to one supplier's model names. It gives every bidder the same target and makes quotes easy to compare. If you are drafting one, we can share the technical details of our products, including product area, safe play area, recommended age group and materials. That helps your engineers set requirements that match real equipment.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: What to include in a playground specification

items: The age groups to be served and the number of children expected at one time.
Materials, for example galvanised steel frames and roto-moulded plastic parts.
Product area and safe play area for each item, with impact-absorbing flooring over the safe zone.
Warranty period by component, installation method and the after-sales contact.

c: Our warranty is 3 years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and 1 year on springs, bearings and spare parts. Our

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,430 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you quote against our tender specification?
items.a: Yes. Share the specification and site details, and we will quote for equipment that meets it. Where one of our products differs from a requirement, we say so clearly in the quote.

items.q: Where can we find product dimensions and safe play areas?
items.a: Each product page on our website lists the product area, safe play area and age group. We can also send these details together in a table for your engineers. Ask for them early, before the tender goes out.

items.q: Do you supply company townships in Jamshedpur?
items.a: Yes. Townships, schools, clubs and housing colonies in Jamshedpur can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install with our own team or a dealer in eastern India.
